Sources: decompiled/main/main_0052.c:53644-53720; decompiled/main/main_0170.c:53416-53445; tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:78,12687.

Returns one of the small result codes 0-5 from a decision tree of accepted context checks: query_attribute_context_status, attribute_context_property_0x00_is_1, attribute_context_selector_9_mapped_value_is_nonzero, and additional status selector checks. The return branches assign codes 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 (the fall-through path returns 0). No indexed caller is available, so the label stays at the observable classification level. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0123.c:12247-12321; tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:12129,12141,12282.

The body loops over up to 30 strided records after context-status gates, looks up each row, applies candidate validation and record predicates, and for qualifying entries ORs 0x8000 into the 32-bit word at row+0x24. It returns whether a qualifying record was marked. Its indexed caller invokes it only when context status selector 0x14 equals 4. Source: decompiled/main/main_0057.c:41858-41958 and caller at decompiled/main/main_0058.c:16332-16340 (corrected during QA).
